sourceBatchSize.description: Number of sources to process in a single batch.

allSources.description:
If true, retries all sources, not just the ones that failed.

Ignored if #sources is specified.
NOTE: if this is set to true, then all checkpoints will be ignored.

sources.description: If specified, only retries the given (by file path) sources.

ignoreCheckpoints.description:
If true, then all sources which are being re-processed will be restarted from the beginning instead of from the
latest available checkpoint.

title: A spec for controlling the behavior of {GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job.Run#retry}
name: GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job.RetrySpec
